mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_diagnosis_result ( circuit_id, frame_id, verdict, confidence, n_samples, warning, trigger_type, risk_level, risk_score, anomaly, anomaly_score, predicted_current ) VALUES ( #{circuitId}, #{frameId}, #{verdict}, #{confidence}, #{nSamples}, #{warning}, #{triggerType}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskScore}, #{anomaly}, #{anomalyScore}, #{predictedCurrent} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.panel_id, p.m_no FROM panel p INNER JOIN site s ON s.site_id = p.site_id INNER JOIN circuit c ON c.panel_id = p.panel_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.m_no IS NOT NULL AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sensor_frame_circuit sfc INNER JOIN sensor_frame sf ON sf.frame_id = sfc.frame_id WHERE sfc.circuit_id = c.circuit_id AND sf.frame_id > COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(ai.frame_id) FROM ai_diagnosis_result ai WHERE ai.circuit_id = c.circuit_id ), 0) ) >= #{minSampleSize} ORDER BY p.panel_id ASC

SELECT c.circuit_id, c.channel_no, MAX(sf.frame_id) AS latest_frame_id FROM circuit c INNER JOIN sensor_frame_circuit sfc ON sfc.circuit_id = c.circuit_id INNER JOIN sensor_frame sf ON sf.frame_id = sfc.frame_id WHERE c.panel_id = #{panelId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND sf.frame_id > COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(ai.frame_id) FROM ai_diagnosis_result ai WHERE ai.circuit_id = c.circuit_id ), 0) GROUP BY c.circuit_id, c.channel_no HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minSampleSize} ORDER BY c.channel_no ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT result_id, circuit_id, frame_id, verdict, confidence, n_samples, warning, trigger_type, diagnosed_at, risk_level, risk_score, anomaly, anomaly_score, predicted_current FROM ai_diagnosis_result WHERE circuit_id = #{circuitId} ORDER BY diagnosed_at DESC, result_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT MAX(ai.diagnosed_at) FROM ai_diagnosis_result ai INNER JOIN circuit c ON c.circuit_id = ai.circuit_id WHERE c.panel_id = #{panelId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuit c WHERE c.panel_id = #{panelId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ai.circuit_id) FROM ai_diagnosis_result ai INNER JOIN circuit c ON c.circuit_id = ai.circuit_id WHERE c.panel_id = #{panelId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.circuit_id, c.channel_no, COUNT(sfc.reading_id) AS sample_count, #{minSampleSize} AS required_sample_count FROM circuit c LEFT JOIN sensor_frame_circuit sfc ON sfc.circuit_id = c.circuit_id AND sfc.frame_id > COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(ai.frame_id) FROM ai_diagnosis_result ai WHERE ai.circuit_id = c.circuit_id ), 0) WHERE c.panel_id = #{panelId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.circuit_id, c.channel_no HAVING COUNT(sfc.reading_id) < #{minSampleSize} ORDER BY c.channel_no ASC
